messages.app.title: Rogue 5.4.4 — Web
messages.app.heading: Into the dungeon.
messages.app.introduction: Play the original rules in your local browser.
messages.app.board: Dungeon. Use the arrow keys to move.
messages.form.name: Name
messages.instruction.movement: Move with arrows or h j k l. Diagonals: y u b n.
messages.instruction.prompts: Answer prompts using their displayed keys. Typing a name or composing text does not send game commands.
messages.instruction.selection: Choose a displayed item key. Original prompts and acknowledgements remain active.
messages.credits.title: Version and license
messages.credits.description: This version uses the C game logic from RRP Rogue 5.4.4. Map glyphs and command keys retain their original form; the presentation uses a separate text catalog.
messages.notice.start: Choose New game to enter the dungeon.
messages.notice.save_pending: Waiting for the save to complete.
messages.notice.saved: Saved in this browser. Resume from the same local URL.
messages.notice.input_flush: The original input handler cancelled {count} queued inputs.
messages.notice.save_cancelled: The input flush also cancelled your save request. Save again when ready.
messages.error.queue_full: The input queue is full. Wait briefly, then try again.
messages.error.isolation: Shared memory is unavailable. Open the game through its local server.
messages.error.seed: Seed must be an integer from 0 to 4294967295.
messages.error.name: Enter a name with at most 49 UTF-8 bytes and no control characters.
messages.error.prompt_text: Enter at most {limit} UTF-8 bytes without control characters.
messages.error.text_composing: Finish composing the text before saving.
messages.error.storage_blocked: Another tab is blocking the save database. Close that tab and retry.
messages.error.save: The save could not be written. Export it or retry after checking browser storage.
messages.error.load: The saved game could not be read or restored.
messages.error.storage_init: Browser save storage could not be initialized.
messages.error.adjacent: Click a square adjacent to your character.
messages.error.runtime: The game could not continue. Try starting again. Technical details are in the diagnostic record.
messages.error.frame: The game screen could not be displayed.
messages.error.presentation: The translated game screen is unavailable in this build.
messages.error.translation: A game text translation is unavailable.
messages.error.catalog: The interface text catalog could not be loaded.
messages.error.tiles: Map images could not load. Please reload the page.
